Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Vince Dizon on Wednesday has ordered to stop the repairs on the Sunog Apog Pumping Station in Tondo, Manila that has been inoperative for five years.

According to Super Radyo dzBB’s Luisito Santos, the DPWH found out that the project started in 2017 but it has yet to resume operation since then.

#tropicswx #PHLwx |
#Bualoi (#OpongPH) continues to strengthen, slowly that is. We have a upper-lvl high bringing E-erly shear to Bualoi so it's a bit of a crutch but given said shear is the same as its movement direction & very high OHC, it should help Bualoi become a brief typhoon before hitting the #Philippines. 

Signal #4 is possible for parts of Luzon & Visayas. Storm surge of 7-9ft (2-2.75m) is also possible. But the biggest threat will be from the flooding where 200-400mm (8-16in) of rain is likely.
